scope: hero-quality Columbidae candidate and the shared Original Bird production system

acceptanceLogic.criticalGateRule: every critical gate must be PASS with attached evidence
acceptanceLogic.nonCriticalGateRule: no FAIL; REVIEW items require an owner, evidence gap and next action
prohibitedAcceptanceShortcuts: approval from a static pose only
hiding defects with dark background, bloom, depth of field or excessive contrast
leaving opaque card backing around feather tips and trailing edges
making the complete feather vane uniformly semi-transparent
using the CC-BY-NC source mesh, textures or animation as the commercial runtime asset
calling artist controls literal anatomical bones without hierarchy, skin and motion evidence
using a lower-quality proxy when a higher-quality source reference is available

gates.title: continuous body carrier
gates.pass: thorax, breast, abdomen, rump, neck base and wing root read as one anatomically continuous mass without sphere/tube seams

gates.title: head-neck-beak proportion
gates.pass: head, multi-segment neck, upper/lower beak and eye placement remain plausible in front, side and three-quarter views

gates.title: wing root and folded-wing volume
gates.pass: wing root emerges from the pectoral region with preserved shoulder volume; folded wing does not look pasted onto the body

gates.title: tail base and fan
gates.pass: tail attaches through the rump and resolves into center plus bilateral rectrix fan, not a single wedge

gates.title: leg-foot-toe contact
gates.pass: leg, knee/ankle chain, foot and toes maintain readable proportions and stable contact without penetration

gates.title: body covert flow
gates.pass: body feather direction follows local surface and hides the carrier without visible tile repetition or floating cards

gates.title: wing hierarchy
gates.pass: coverts, secondaries and primaries are distinct, overlap in the correct direction and preserve span/fold continuity

gates.title: primary separation and alpha edge
gates.pass: primary feathers separate near the tip without comb-like uniform spacing, clipping or identical copies; all card voids are alpha-zero, the vane core stays opaque, and only a narrow directional barb fringe is partially transparent with no gray plate or dark halo

gates.title: tail hierarchy
gates.pass: tail rectrices overlap, fan and close without gaps through the tail base; the perimeter uses the same transparent-void and soft-fringe rule

gates.title: micro variation
gates.pass: length, curvature, edge wear, alpha-fringe width and orientation variation are subtle, non-random and region-aware

gates.title: feather response
gates.pass: feathers remain non-metallic with controlled roughness and directional highlight; no global plastic coat, no opaque sheet backing, no whole-vane glass transparency and no filtering halo

gates.title: eye separation
gates.pass: cornea, iris/pupil and surrounding eyelid/feather boundary are materially distinct at macro distance

gates.title: beak keratin
gates.pass: beak has keratin-like roughness/translucency cues and a clean upper/lower boundary without sharing feather response

gates.title: foot and claw material
gates.pass: foot skin/scales and claw keratin are distinct from feathers and do not appear rubbery or metallic

gates.title: lighting robustness
gates.pass: material and alpha roles remain readable under neutral, grazing, overcast and back/rim inspection lights and on bright-gray, sky-blue and warm-gray backgrounds

gates.title: shoulder volume preservation
gates.pass: pectoral/shoulder volume does not collapse or inflate through the full wing cycle

gates.title: elbow-wrist-manus fold
gates.pass: wing folding follows a coherent shoulder-humerus-forearm-wrist-manus chain without rubber bending

gates.title: feather attachment stability
gates.pass: coverts, secondaries, primaries and tail feathers remain attached and do not swim, detach, invert, sort-pop or expose card backing

gates.title: neck-head continuity
gates.pass: neck bends without pinching, head detachment or sudden volume change

gates.title: ground-contact deformation
gates.pass: feet and toes settle on contact, do not skate, jitter or penetrate, and preserve toe spread

gates.title: phase continuity
gates.pass: at least eight normalized phase samples show continuous position, orientation and feather-alpha stability without pops, loop discontinuity or transparency flicker

gates.title: whole-body coupling
gates.pass: wing, thorax, tail, neck, head and legs participate coherently instead of isolated wing flapping

gates.title: takeoff and landing
gates.pass: leg impulse, first wingbeat, tail fan, approach deceleration and foot contact are separate readable events

gates.title: flight-mode separation
gates.pass: flap, glide, climb, descent and approach have distinct posture and timing, not only playback-speed changes

gates.title: living idle
gates.pass: breathing, head attention, balance and small feather response create life without repetitive mechanical noise

gates.title: distance readability
gates.pass: macro reveals material and alpha separation, portrait reveals anatomy/feather hierarchy, gameplay distance preserves species silhouette and motion without feather thickening or disappearance

gates.title: mobile evidence
gates.pass: triangle, material, draw-call, texture-memory, transparent-overdraw and frame-time evidence are recorded on the target mobile path; increases require visible A/B benefit

gates.title: no traditional LOD substitution
gates.pass: one coherent asset definition is retained; flock scale uses shared geometry, instancing and state data rather than unrelated lower-quality bird replacements

gates.title: clean runtime package
gates.pass: HTML workbench opens directly, has no black default review background, no missing network asset, no console error and no source-license dependency

gates.title: flock compatibility
gates.pass: individual variation, formation, separation, alignment, cohesion, habitat and predator-risk states do not break hero-bird anatomy, animation or alpha ordering
